notes.title: Blight forest update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just released a free content update to Senna and the Forest. A new chapter containing three levels, that feature a new twist to the original tree-investigation mechanic! Join Senna in investigating a forest crippled by the disease known as The Blight, that moves from one tree to the next. Talk to the trees, and use the clues they give to determine the order in which trees are attacked and understand the movement of the Blight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35490651/3ef83372f14c09b12d5d99e8d5f60279501349b9.gif[/img]

Venture deeper and use the magical powers of old shrines to remove the Blight and cure the forest. The two chapters currently in the game can be played independently.

notes.title: Achievements update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've added a minor update to the game in the form of an achievement. Now it's extremely easy to 100% the game, all you need to do is finish it! For those of you who've already finished the game, opening the game once should register the achievement and unlock it!

We're also working on a new area in the game which will feature a new mystery to uncover using the investigation mechanic, that we've all grown to know and (hopefully) love, but with a twist making it all the more interesting.

We'll have more news about the update soon! Until then happy playing, and don't forget to be nice to your neighbourhood trees! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Senna and the Forest Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone

I am Senna and welcome to my game!

Senna and the Forest releases on the [b]7th of August [/b] and I can't wait for you to join me on this adventure! 

But before you dive in let me give you a bit of history. This game is set in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Bhumi, where mankind's dominance over nature no longer exists. You see a long time ago....

Ah, the developers are asking me to wrap it up! 

Oh well, join me in the game and you'll understand everything about this world! Also if you haven't wishlisted the game now's a great time to do so! 

I think I'll take a nap now underneath this conveniently placed tree. But If you have any questions about the game don't hesitate to wake me up and ask!
